items.title: Wilbert Tillman Interview, 1966-01-20
items.q: I know Booker T played with him for a while.

ctx.x: What did Garnier play? Garnier was trumpet player.

Is that the Jalma Garnier? Yeah. That's who I thought you were talking about. Yeah. That's who I thought you were talking about. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. He's the only one I know around here. He might have some. I know Booker T played with him for a while. I don't know.
Yeah. But he was probably playing bass drums. And Didi played with him for a while, I know. Yeah.
